purpose: Close the distinction between failure of complete Liouville integrability and absence of even one additional meromorphic first integral.
goal: Reproduce and qualify the Morales-Ruiz--Simon positive-mass three-body one-integral obstruction, including the mass branches left exceptional by the earlier parabolic-Lagrange first-NVE argument.
evidence_boundary: A PASS qualifies a pinned published theorem plus a project-owned exact audit of its mass algebra and independent Hessian specializations. The theorem concerns meromorphic first integrals of the unreduced Newtonian vector field that are independent with all classical first integrals. It does not automatically become a theorem about a function defined only on one fixed-momentum reduced leaf, does not exclude non-meromorphic integrals, and does not say that the same single witness curve obstructs every mass triple.

model.potential: Newtonian, homogeneous of degree -1, on one meromorphic determination of the algebraic distance extension
model.known_integrals: energy, center-of-mass/linear-momentum integrals, and angular-momentum components (the classical integrals)
model.witnesses: two homothetic Lagrange central-configuration phase curves used according to the exact mass branch

theorem_obligations.R1: Pin and machine-check the 2009 primary theorem statement, scope, positive-mass domain, and arbitrary-dimension conclusion.
theorem_obligations.R2: Reproduce the symmetric mass invariant Q=(m1*m2+m2*m3+m3*m1)/(m1+m2+m3)^2 and prove 0<Q<=1/3 exactly.
theorem_obligations.R3: Reproduce the real Lagrange Hessian nonclassical spectrum lambda_pm=-1/2 plus or minus (3/2)*sqrt(1-3Q).
theorem_obligations.R4: Audit the first necessary-condition branch and show that its only positive-mass candidate is Q=8/27.
theorem_obligations.R5: Audit the eigenvalue-equivalence branch and show that its only positive-mass candidate on the real witness is Q=1/3.
theorem_obligations.R6: Reproduce the second complex Lagrange witness branch and the exact contradictions that remove Q=8/27 and Q=1/3.
theorem_obligations.R7: Record the earlier Tsygvintsev first-NVE polynomial-invariant set {1/3,8/27,2/9} and prove that it is not an exception set to the 2009 one-integral theorem.
theorem_obligations.R8: Independently construct and differentiate the mass-weighted Newtonian potential at exact benchmark central configurations without importing production formulas.
theorem_obligations.R9: State the local/global and unreduced/fixed-leaf logical boundary without transfer by implication.
theorem_obligations.R10: Reject all shortened claims that omit meromorphicity, independence from classical integrals, or witness-domain scope.

independent_validation.production: Dependency-light exact Fraction certificates for the mass domain, branch implications, and theorem decision.
independent_validation.reference: A source-disjoint SymPy construction of the mass-weighted potential, Lagrange central configurations, Hessians, spectra, and branch identities.

adversarial_controls: Reject zero, negative, nonfinite, malformed, and wrong-count masses.
Detect a changed Q formula or Lagrange eigenvalue polynomial.
Detect omission of the second witness.
Detect treating a legacy first-NVE polynomial invariant as an actual first integral.
Detect transfer to a fixed reduced leaf without a separate theorem.
Reject a reference implementation that imports production.

decision_policy.PASS: Every source, exact mass branch, independent Hessian, adversarial, proof-coverage, and boundary gate passes under a frozen implementation.
decision_policy.AUTHORIZED_CLAIM: For every finite positive mass triple and every integer d>=2, the pinned Morales-Ruiz--Simon theorem, with the project-owned exact branch reproduction, excludes a meromorphic first integral of the Newtonian three-body vector field that is functionally independent of the classical first integrals. For each mass triple the proof supplies an obstruction near at least one of its declared homothetic Lagrange witness curves.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_FIXED_LEAF_CLAIM: No additional first integral exists on every fixed-energy or fixed-angular-momentum reduced leaf.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_REGULARITY_CLAIM: No additional continuous, smooth, real-analytic, or non-meromorphic first integral exists.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_UNIFORM_WITNESS_CLAIM: One named Lagrange curve obstructs all masses without branch selection.

invalidation: Any changed theorem statement, source payload, mass domain, witness branch, proof obligation, decision rule, or frozen implementation invalidates v1.
